about: The scenarios page (/scenarios/), following the AgoraScenarios board of October 31, 2026 and backed by site/evidence/sira-are-cascade-2026-10-31/scenario_matrix_1000_digest.json (SHA-256 f99b3becdcffd84ff6228eedb2b0f789d65ea9ce30e4103f51c387a0ee69616d). Plain words throughout.
title: Scenarios · 1,000 made-up scenarios checked against queue rules | Agora · ta-amps
description: 1,000 made-up scenarios across 25 kinds of work checked deterministically against queue privacy, split-execution, latency, and distinct-reviewer rules (seed 20261031, zero model calls).
heading: 1,000 made-up scenarios, checked against the same rules
lead: We generated situations, methods, people, and stakeholders, and checked each combination against the written rules the queue uses: files that must stay local, a second distinct checker, and time limits. Nothing here is a real nonprofit request, and zero model calls were made. Anyone can re-run it from seed 20261031.

tiles.label: Approved as asked
tiles.sub: The rules allowed the work exactly as described.

tiles.label: Approved after a split
tiles.sub: Private files stayed local; only public parts went to volunteers.

tiles.label: Blocked
tiles.sub: A rule or a stakeholder stopped it, with the reason recorded.

why_blocked.heading: Why scenarios were blocked
why_blocked.lead: A scenario can be blocked for more than one reason: 470 recorded reasons across 325 blocked scenarios.

reasons.label: Needed the cloud, but the work had to stay offline
Mixed private and public data, not split
Sensitive data would have left the building
A stakeholder vetoed cloud use for sensitive data

stakeholders.heading: Who objected most
stakeholders.lead: Share of their 100 scenarios each stakeholder blocked.

items.text: Rural shelter intake transcription, checked locally with a paired holdout. The rules allowed it as described.
items.became: a task object for checking transcriptions against held-out samples.
items.human: crisis follow-up, bed allocation, and intake sign-off.

items.text: Intake work paired with public resource research. Handwritten statements stayed on the shelter’s computer; public budget lines went to volunteers.
items.became: a task object for the two-step check by a distinct reviewer.
items.human: crisis follow-up, bed allocation, and intake sign-off.

items.text: Asked a cloud model to read sensitive statements in an offline setting. Two rules stopped it before any work could queue.
items.became: a guardrail: sensitive files never go to a cloud tier unsplit.
items.human: crisis follow-up, bed allocation, and intake sign-off.
